SF-16
Sfl - FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE FUEL PUMP ASSEMBLY FROM FUEL TANK (5ee page SF-11)
2. REMOVE NO. 1 FUEL SUCTION SUPPORT (See page SF-12)
3. REMOVE FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR
(a) Pull out the pressure regulator.
(b) Remove the 0-ring from the pressure regulator.
